what: 0.2.5: issue #2 (github.com/rulith-dev/strixllama/issues/2) - a ROCm 'unspecified launch failure' on a large text prefill after many images in a conversation; its cause and the fix (apply_image_dense_bound)
setup: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next UD-IQ4_XS, F16 mmproj, context 262144, f16 K/V, QSA on, vision on, one slot, MTP with the shared Q4_K_M / IQ4_XS head and draft_max 2, the disk tier on, batch = ubatch = 8192 (the reporter's configuration). tools/vision_long_append.py on a server started as production (tmp/kvr/with_server.py): ~58K tokens of generated numbered records, 27 generated 1920x1080 PNGs in seven turns of 4,4,4,4,4,4,3 with the whole history kept (~114K tokens), a short text turn, then ~14K tokens more records. temperature 0, seed 42, 64 tokens, cache_prompt on, thinking off. Memory from tmp/kvr/gpu_mem_monitor.ps1 every 2-3 s: the server's shared and dedicated GPU memory (Windows GPU Process Memory counters), available RAM, free commit. Ryzen AI Max+ 395, 96 GB carve, 31.6 GB of RAM visible to Windows, TdrDelay 60 s.

reproduction_0_2_4.result: the append failed after 3.3-6.6 s with 'ROCm error: unspecified launch failure', in four runs of four
reproduction_0_2_4.not_tdr: TdrDelay is 60 s on this machine and the fault came within seconds, so this is not a GPU timeout
reproduction_0_2_4.one_image_control: the same lengths with one image (106K of text, one image, 14K append) completed, with and without serialized kernels
reproduction_0_2_4.serialized: AMD_SERIALIZE_KERNEL=3, AMD_SERIALIZE_COPY=3, graphs off, a sync before every node: the first node of the append's first ubatch (5811 tokens), the token-embedding GET_ROWS from the pinned host buffer, faulted with every index in range

cause: Once an image is in a conversation every later ubatch takes the dense sparse-attention inputs: a KQ mask and a per-block bias over n_kv x n_tokens, ~6.6 bytes a pair, staged in the pinned host compute buffer. They grow with every image, so that buffer was reallocated for almost every image (GGML_ALLOC_DEBUG: ROCm_Host 269 -> 271, 296 -> 298, 324 -> 346 MiB ... ), and ROCm on Windows keeps each freed pinned buffer: the server's shared GPU memory rose ~0.45 GB an image, 1.5 -> 13.7 GB, and available RAM fell 17 -> 3.4 GB. The first large batch after that faulted. One image per request at short context does not show it (the buffer grows once); the growth is in chunks and scales with the context. Not the legacy CUDA pool (no new pool allocations), not the disk tier (nothing is written for a conversation with images). GGML_CUDA_NO_PINNED=1 is not a way out: the runtime reads host buffers from the GPU and faults at warmup without pinned memory.

fix.dense_ubatch_bound: once a conversation holds an image (or a position gap, the sticky kb_dup), its ubatches are held to n_kv x n_tokens <= 2^27 (STRIX_DENSE_UBATCH_BUDGET; about 1024 tokens at 128K cells, 512 at 256K). Text before any image keeps the full ubatch
fix.buffer_growth: a compute buffer that has to grow again grows by at least a quarter (on top of the 3% + 16 MiB headroom since 0.1.12), so it is reallocated a handful of times per process instead of once per image
fix.fault_report: a kernel fault reported after an op now names the node, its sources, and where each lies in its buffer

fixed_budget_2_27.chosen: the default: half the memory of 2^28 for 6% on a long text append to an image conversation
